Eli: Morning team—saw a weird pattern: onboarding benches for region-specific models are queued behind global tiny-model benches. leads to missed regional regressions.
Maya: I think the scheduler treats all jobs equal; smaller runtime jobs complete faster and keep re-entering the queue. not ideal for regional coverage.
Omar: Proposal: introduce a "coverage credit" per model-region pair. each safety bench consumes 1 credit; credits refill slowly. credits ensure each region gets at least N safety benches per day.
Zoe: Nice. How do credits interact with backpressure? If cluster degrades, we still want to protect safety benches but maybe reduce regional frequency slightly.
Eli: Policy idea: two-tier credit system: base_credits (guaranteed min) + burst_credits (borrowable, reclaimed under stress). when runtime_signal==degraded, reclaim burst_credits and only allow base_credits to be spent.
Maya: That keeps guarantees but preserves safety. We need an API for intake: `POST /intake/coverage_request { model_id, region, lane_hint }` -> returns `{ request_id, lane_assigned, credits_used, eta, signed_ticket }` (signed_ticket is string). Workers must present the ticket.
Omar: We'll sign tickets with short TTL. Private deployments keep keys local. Add note: verify signature and check `credits_used` on worker side.
Zoe: For validation pipelines, add deterministic golden sampling: a small fixed set of prompts per region that rotate weekly. benches should include `golden_id` and `expected_hash`. If hash mismatch -> create an incident and open escalation ticket with `request_id`.
Eli: Preemption: if a golden mismatch occurs in safety lane, immediately reserve next slot in that region's queue and mark `priority=urgent`. This may delay opportunistic benches by one slot. allowed preemptions per-hour must be limited (configurable).
Maya: Operational signals: instrument `credits_remaining`, `avg_wait_by_region`, `preemptions_count`. show as heatmap on Console and export to metrics pipeline.
Omar: Edge-case: models with very low traffic might hoard credits. We'll add an aging policy: credits decay if unused for T days and then re-distribute to global opportunistic pool. audit trail required.
Zoe: Implementation plan: Omar will add credit ledger + ticket signing in intake; Maya will add metrics and Console surface; Eli will write the RFC addendum for credit economics and preemption knobs.
prober-signal-bot: runtime_p95 spike detected (1.9x) in west-us at 1735002500 — recommending reclaiming burst_credits.
Eli: Perfect timing. Let's run a canary with reclaimed burst_credits tomorrow and watch `avg_wait_by_region`.
Maya: I'll set alerts for `preemptions_count` > 5/hr. Also add tracing fields `request_id`, `golden_id`, and `ticket_sig`.
Omar: I'll submit the intake proto PR and include a test harness for ticket verification.
Zoe: Thanks all. This should improve regional coverage without blowing up the runtime. :thumbsup:
